generation.method: OpenAI built-in image generation, one generation per episode, followed by a centered 1600 x 900 WebP export
generation.sharedDirection: Premium cinematic 3D scientific editorial illustration on deep charcoal, with cyan structure and restrained amber emphasis. Keep the focal subject central and leave dark edge space for responsive website overlays.
generation.excluded: Embedded text, numbers, logos, watermarks, identifiable people, fake clinical scans, gore, treatment promises, and purple-dominant palettes

notes: These clean, text-free derivatives are approved for the website. Direct-channel thumbnails may need platform-specific text and safe-area variants before replacement. Generated originals remain outside the repository in the local Codex image output store.
